title: Meeting Notes config.json
description: Settings in ~/.config/meeting-notes/config.json, edited by the Settings window, the command line, MCP or by hand. Missing keys use their defaults. See docs/automation.md.

autoRecordTeamsMeetings.description: Record when a Teams meeting is joined and transcribe after leaving it.

mirrorTeamsMute.description: Exclude the microphone while Teams shows you as muted, for recordings of Teams audio.

localSpeakerName.description: Label for everything the microphone records. null uses the Teams display name once seen, otherwise the macOS full name.

retention.description: Audio storage budget; the oldest eligible recordings above it are deleted. Transcripts are always kept.

agentsMayNameMeetings.description: Allow connected agents to name meetings without a title when reading them. Existing titles stay unchanged.

agentsMaySummarizeMeetings.description: Nudge connected agents to save a short summary while reading a complete meeting.

keepAudio.description: Keep audio after successful transcription. When false, newly completed audio is deleted and failed work is kept for retry. Settings also offers to delete existing completed audio.

agentsMayCorrectTranscripts.description: Nudge connected agents to fix clear transcription errors while reading, without rewriting or guessing. Explicitly requested corrections remain available when disabled.
